title: Malaria Country Profiles
text:
Malaria Epidemiological Profiles
    
      Every Country's Malaria Situation
      In One Standard Format
    
    
      Source-backed epidemiology profiles burden, interventions, health systems,
      and vector ecology compiled and maintained by the MAP Data Engineering Team.

    ⌄
  



  
    
      🧭 OUR APPROACH
      One Template. Every Country.
      No matter who submits it, every profile follows the same evidence-backed structure from burden data to vector ecology.
    
    
      
        
          
            🗂️
            One structure, every country
            Every profile follows the same template introduction, burden, health system, vectors, references so countries are easy to compare.
          
        
      
      
        
          
            📎
            Every figure is sourced
            Statistics, tables, and maps carry a year and a source DHS, DHIS2, National Strategic Plans, or peer-reviewed literature.
          
        
      
      
        
          
            🔄
            Living documents
            Profiles are revisited as new surveys, stratifications, and strategic plans are released.
